# Submitting your first job bundle

A job bundle pairs an Open Job Description template with the files your job needs.

1. Create a directory named `my_bundle` containing a `template.yaml`.
2. Submit it with `deadline bundle submit my_bundle`.
3. Watch progress in the Deadline Cloud monitor.
